assumptions.statement: Official exact boundary, key-area polygons, regulatory controls, ownership, road redlines, utilities, fire access and engineering constraints are not supplied in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All siting, land-use cells, alignments and dimensions remain conceptual and require full replacement or recalculation before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: The repository provisional site is used only as a reproducible working envelope; issue #846 records about 412.5 m nearest separation and zero overlap against one OSM-mapped park polygon.
assumptions.impact: Neither geometry is promoted to an official redline; official polygons trigger complete spatial, metric, figure and PDF regeneration.

assumptions.statement: Public reporting in August 2026 describes the roughly nine-kilometre park corridor as open; the reported area is background context and not a boundary source.
assumptions.impact: The proposal adds edge interfaces and operations rather than claiming to rebuild or remap the park.

assumptions.statement: The complete land-use partition is a non-statutory character and coordination diagram created to satisfy reproducible spatial review.
assumptions.impact: It does not assign parcels, ownership, demolition, FAR, building height or legal land-use rights.

assumptions.statement: Service windows, consolidation rules, robot speeds and performance targets are pilot hypotheses.
assumptions.impact: Traffic, public-security, fire, accessibility, labour, merchant and neighbourhood review must set any final operating protocol.

assumptions.statement: Verified heritage protection boundaries and a full building survey are absent.
assumptions.impact: No verified heritage element is proposed for demolition; reversible modules avoid attachment until heritage review confirms locations.

assumptions.statement: Operational indicators have transparent formulas and concept targets but no claimed current values.
assumptions.impact: A baseline and an approved measurement plan are prerequisites to evaluate benefit or continue a pilot.

assumptions.statement: AI and robotic services remain supervised public tests with an offline equivalent, a named human steward, data minimisation and a physical stop path.
assumptions.impact: Failure of safety, equity, privacy, noise or complaint-closure gates suspends the corresponding test.
